$comment: The libraries this site publishes. Add an entry and the next sync pulls that repo's docs/ folder. Fields are described in docs/CONTRACT.md.

site.title: khangle.dev docs
site.description: Command-line tools and libraries by Khang Le that help Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents read Jira, Outline and Figma, follow your rules, and share state in React apps.

libraries.title: hookmux
libraries.blurb: Write an agent hook once as a plugin and run it in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and more.

libraries.title: jira-cli
libraries.blurb: Search and update issues on a self-hosted Jira Server, with results your agent can read.

libraries.title: outline-cli
libraries.blurb: Let an agent search, read and safely edit your Outline knowledge base.

libraries.title: figma-lens
libraries.blurb: Inspect Figma files without opening Figma: find screens, read layout and type, export assets.

libraries.title: @khanglvm/react
libraries.blurb: Shared state with rollback, typed translations and async events between React components.

libraries.title: Refract
libraries.blurb: Scoped React state: components read slices through selectors, update with Immer drafts and can undo any update.
